title: Check Current and Archived Robot Task Records
summary: Use read-only SSMS access to the Robotics database to determine whether a tote task requested by the Sorter Sweeper module is present in the current Robot Task database model table or has been archived to Robot Task Activity.
when_to_use: Use SSMS against the WCS / Helix Robotics database when troubleshooting a tote task requested by the Sorter Sweeper module and determining whether the task is still current or has completed and been archived.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to modify Robot Task or Robot Task Activity records.
Do not treat a completed task as current solely because it is no longer present in the current Robot Task database model table.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Perform the read-only Robotics database inspection in SSMS and classify the task as current or archived.
Review ambiguous, missing, or conflicting task records when escalation is required.

safety_notes: This is a read-only database diagnostic. Do not alter Robot Task or Robot Task Activity records.

access_required: Read access to the Robotics database through WCS / Helix DB (SSMS).
system_preconditions: The tote task requested by the Sorter Sweeper module must be identifiable for lookup.

steps.title: Open the Robotics database in SSMS
steps.purpose: Access the live WCS / Helix database surface that contains the current and archived Robot Task records.
steps.instruction: In SSMS, open the Robotics database and locate the Robot Task database model table.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Task database model table is available for read-only inspection in the Robotics database.
steps.healthy_condition: SSMS provides access to the Robotics database and the Robot Task database model table can be located.
steps.failure_condition: The Robotics database or Robot Task database model table cannot be accessed or located.

actions.label: Open Robotics database
actions.exact_action: Open the Robotics database in SSMS.

actions.label: Locate current task table
actions.exact_action: Locate the Robot Task database model table.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the Robotics database or Robot Task database model table is unavailable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Robot Task database model table tracks the status of the tote task requested by the Sorter Sweeper module.

steps.title: Check the current Robot Task record
steps.purpose: Determine whether the requested tote task remains in the current Robot Task records.
steps.instruction: In the SSMS Robot Task database model table, inspect the record for the tote task requested by the Sorter Sweeper module and determine whether the task is present.
steps.expected_result: The requested tote task is either found as a row in the current Robot Task database model table or is not present there.
steps.healthy_condition: A current or in-progress tote task has a corresponding row in the Robot Task database model table.
steps.failure_condition: The task is expected to be current but no corresponding row is present in the Robot Task database model table.

actions.label: Inspect current task record
actions.exact_action: Check the record for the tote task requested by the Sorter Sweeper module in the Robot Task database model table.

stop_or_escalate_if: Continue to the archived-record check if the task is not present in the current table.
Escalate if the task cannot be identified for lookup.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Robot Task database model table tracks the status of the tote task requested by the Sorter Sweeper module.

steps.title: Check Robot Task Activity for a completed task
steps.purpose: Determine whether a task that is no longer current has been archived after completion.
steps.instruction: If the tote task is complete or is not present in the current Robot Task database model table, inspect Robot Task Activity in the Robotics database for the archived task record.
steps.expected_result: A completed tote task is found in Robot Task Activity rather than being treated as a current task.
steps.healthy_condition: The task is present in Robot Task Activity and is absent from the current Robot Task database model table after completion.
steps.failure_condition: The task is absent from both the current Robot Task database model table and Robot Task Activity, or the records do not provide a determinable task state.

actions.label: Inspect archived task record
actions.exact_action: Check Robot Task Activity for the archived record.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate when the tote task cannot be found in either the current Robot Task table or Robot Task Activity.
Escalate when the task status cannot be determined from the available records.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: When tasks are complete, they're archived to Robot Task Activity. There is one table that is current and one that is archived.

steps.title: Classify the task as current or archived
steps.purpose: Record the live database state without changing task or activity records.
steps.instruction: Record the task as current when its row is present in the Robot Task database model table. Record it as archived when the completed task is present in Robot Task Activity and is no longer treated as current.
steps.expected_result: The task has one clear classification: current or archived, based on the corresponding Robotics database row.
steps.healthy_condition: A current task is represented in the current Robot Task database model table, or a completed task is represented in Robot Task Activity.
steps.failure_condition: The same task appears simultaneously current and archived, or its state cannot be determined from the available rows.

actions.label: Record task state
actions.exact_action: Record whether the task is current or archived based on the row's presence in the corresponding table.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate when a task appears simultaneously current and archived.
Escalate when the task status cannot be determined from the available records.
Do not alter task or activity records.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Robot Task database model table is current, while completed tasks are archived to Robot Task Activity.

success_criteria: The requested tote task is located in either the current Robot Task database model table or Robot Task Activity.
The task is classified as current or archived from its live Robotics database row.
No Robot Task or Robot Task Activity records are modified.
healthy_conditions: An in-progress or otherwise current tote task is present in the Robot Task database model table.
A completed tote task is present in Robot Task Activity and is not treated as current after archival.
failure_conditions: The tote task cannot be found in either the current Robot Task database model table or Robot Task Activity.
The task appears simultaneously in current and archived records.
The task state cannot be determined from the available Robotics database records.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to L3_support when the tote task is missing from both current and archived records.
Escalate to L3_support when current and archived records conflict or the task state is indeterminate.
Do not modify task or activity records while investigating.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: The Robot Task database model table tracks the status of tote tasks requested by the Sorter Sweeper module. Completed tasks are archived to Robot Task Activity.
